title: Mock: Hotel Reservation System
summary: Room-type inventory over date ranges, room assignment, a booking lifecycle (booked → checked in → checked out), extra charges and billing.
hints: A booking holds one concrete room for nights `[checkIn, checkOut)`. A room is free if none of its active bookings overlap.
Assign the **lowest room number** of the requested type that is free for every night.
Lifecycle: BOOKED → CHECKED_IN → CHECKED_OUT, and BOOKED → CANCELLED. Use a small transition check.
Bill = nights × nightly rate + the sum of extra charges added while checked in.
